completeness.why: upcoming-dates and both template sites pass their raw skipWeekend and mode fields to applyWeekendRule/applyWeekendRuleToDay (day/date conversion is their own data handling). next-date calls applyWeekendRule but still computes the enable flag itself as `!!skipWeekend && !noSkipWeekend` instead of passing noSkipWeekend as an explicit option. That single-site variation could arguably stay local, but the case sits between levels, so it is scored partial.

interface.why: Takes the real variation (enable flag, solve mode), keeps per-caller field mapping, and makes getDateWithSkippedWeekend private. There are two entry points (Date and day string) with an awkward generic `T | string` return, and the getNextDate-only noSkipWeekend override is folded into the flag rather than named.

disguised_duplication.where: shared/schedules.ts applyWeekendRuleToDay repeats the `skipWeekend ? getDateWithSkippedWeekend(...) : date` ternary of applyWeekendRule around a parse/format, instead of delegating to applyWeekendRule.
